steps.hardClue: Summon four champions, defeat them and place their heads on spikes.
steps.clue: Ring the four tower gongs, defeat their champions and place their heads on the spikes.

steps.hardClue: Grind a marked skull into powder, then combine it with burnt wood and dung to make fertilizer.
steps.clue: Obtain the Death of Orion and combine bone meal, burnt wood and dung to create fertilizer.

steps.hardClue: Get a Fire Bomb kill over the fertilizer, then destroy three red pods throughout the tower.
steps.clue: Get a Fire Bomb kill over the fertilizer, then destroy the three red pods throughout Danu Tower.

steps.hardClue: Ignite four hidden symbols with the shield, then defeat the summoned champions.
steps.clue: Ignite the four bull symbols with the Brazen Bull, then defeat the summoned champions.

steps.hardClue: Read the obelisk and kill the special enemies in the displayed order.
steps.clue: Read the Ra Obelisk and kill the special enemies in the displayed order.

steps.hardClue: Raise four metal rods, charge them with electrical kills and survive the challenge.
steps.clue: Raise the four metal rods, charge them using Kill-O-Watt and survive the Arena challenge.

steps.hardClue: Hit three symbol sets with one shot each, then survive the three-phase lockdown.
steps.clue: Shoot the three symbol sets with Serket’s Kiss and survive the lockdown in The Pit.

steps.hardClue: Enter the portal and defeat waves of warriors and beasts.
steps.clue: Enter the Arena portal and defeat the waves of Gladiators and Tigers.

steps.hardClue: Defeat the two enormous armored beasts.
steps.clue: Defeat Fury and Wrath, the two war elephants.
